issues: Fanfare ability is missing the [cost04] activation requirement; encode the fanfare with a 4 PP cost in addition to the Earth Rite condition.

Start-of-end ability is incorrectly encoded with irrelevant cemetery and selfDefense conditions; it should trigger at the start of your end phase only if your leader's defense is 5 or less, then heal your leader by 5 and draw 1. Implement a leader-defense-threshold condition such as condition.type 'selfLeaderDefMax' with count 5.

Activated ability is incorrectly encoded as [cost01], engage; the source text is [cost01], Lesson (1). Encode the correct Lesson cost instead of engage. Since Lesson cost is not available in the reference, implement an activated cost field for Lesson, e.g. cost.lesson: 1.

Fanfare should always select an enemy follower first, then destroy it only if there are at least 10 iM@S CG cards in your cemetery; parsed effect makes the target exist only inside the condition and also uses the wrong cemetery condition. Encode a target-first conditional destroy, and implement a condition for cemetery trait count such as condition.type 'ownCemeteryTraitMin' with trait 'iM@S CG' and count 10.

Activated ability cost is encoded incorrectly as pp 1, engage, discard; the source text is Lesson (1), engage, discard a card. Replace pp 1 with the proper Lesson cost. Since Lesson cost is not available in the reference, implement an activated cost field for Lesson, e.g. cost.lesson: 1.

Activated ability uses unsupported cost field 'discard'; encode the discard-a-card cost using an implemented hand-discard cost shape, or add support for a generic activated discard cost such as cost.discardFromHand/count 1.

Passive text 'This can't be played from the EX area' is missing; encode a passive restriction preventing play from EX area. Since no such ability exists in the reference, implement a passive op such as 'cannotPlayFromExArea'.
Parsed passive 'cannotAttack' is incorrect; the source does not say this follower can't attack. Remove that ability.

On-ally-evolve ability should work while this card is in your EX area, but parsed ability has no EX-area condition/activation source and adds the counter to self on field. Encode it to function from EX area, e.g. with activateFrom 'exArea' and condition/sourceInExArea.

On-ally-evolve ability is incomplete; after placing a fighting spirit counter, if this has at least 2 fighting spirit counters, you may summon it and, if you do, evolve it. Add the conditional summon-from-EX-area and evolve sequence. Since the reference lacks a counter-threshold condition, implement one such as condition.type 'selfCounterMin' with counter 'fighting_spirit' and count 2.
Last Words is encoded with moveToExArea targeting self, but the correct implemented form for 'Put this into its owner's EX area' should use moveSourceToExArea.

First activated ability is missing its cost; it should remove 1 fighting spirit counter from this. Encode the cost with removeCounter on this card, and since activated costs do not currently support removeCounter, implement a counter-removal activated cost shape such as cost.removeCounter.

Second activated ability is missing its cost; it should remove 5 fighting spirit counters from this. Encode the cost with removeCounter amount 5 on this card, and since activated costs do not currently support removeCounter, implement a counter-removal activated cost shape such as cost.removeCounter.
